description: A regex on the pact's Content-Type header that expects a space before the charset, and a reply in another charset that the regex allows. Today's verifier passes the header, then checks the same rule against the reply's type written without the space (application/json;charset=iso-8859-1) before it compares the body, and fails it there; janus verify checks the rule once, on the header as sent
source: staged plan S1.26; pact_matching::match_body's content-type gate, which calls match_header_value on ContentType's Display
